cover_headline: Air India Restores Non-Stop Flights to New York, Cutting Travel Time by Five Hours
facts: Air India has restored non-stop flights on all four India-New York routes - Delhi and Mumbai to JFK and Newark - ending the Rome refuelling stop
Flights that took around 22 hours with the Rome stop now take approximately 17 hours
Delhi-JFK and Mumbai-JFK services run daily; Delhi-Newark runs four times a week and Mumbai-Newark three times a week

end.headline: Air India Restores Non-Stop Flights to New York, Cutting Travel Time by Five Hours
end.line: All four routes - Delhi and Mumbai to JFK and Newark - are non-stop again after the Rome refuelling stop was dropped, with journeys down from around 22 hours to approximately 17.
